0) Do I meet the requirements?


Yes I think I do meet the requirements to become admin for Dream Team once again.
_______________________________


1) What is your name? Real & Ingame
My real name is Michal and Ingame I hold the name "OxygeN"


2) How old are you?
Currently I'm 16 years of age and at 31 of July I will turn 17.


3) Why do you want to join our administrative team?
I wanna show myself again for the very last time to the community that I'm more than capable for this role, I know the rules for the TTT server more than enough to server a fluent support for the server, I have also managed to help people without being a admin through reporting a player, I wanna join as there are usually people that are racist, mic spamming, camping or being toxic towards players and I wanna stop this from happening by enforcing rules but also letting people on the server have fun from playing in this community, many people know me and many people support me but there are also players that hate me on the server and I usually try to clear this stuff out by speaking to them via TeamSpeak or messaging them privately on steam where all this stuff can be cleared.


4) How long have you been playing on our servers?
I have joined Dream around April 2016 where I started at the Knife server, then I found out about the forum and decided to register in May 2016, I have meet a lot of great people in the past time such as Mario, Doo Doo.


On the TTT server I have around 7K stamm points where on Knife server I have roughly around 15K or so I can't really remember.


5) What are your favorite hobbies or pastimes?
My favorite hobbies did not change, mountain biking through the rough terrain as it gives you a little thrill and excitement, I also like to spend my time well with friends and family which are number one for me also If I don't do any of these above I love to spend my time on Dream Community Knife/TTT server which I really got hold of and made good friends and supporters.


6) Do you think of yourself as mature?
In a sense, I know that few days ago I used to have problems with one of the current administrators @Mas0n but I'm trying to change my behavior and I'm working towards improving myself for this role, when people usually break rules I try warning them nice and calmly if this does not work I will usually try to contact one of the available administrators I have in my friend list, if they don't stop and no admins are available I would usually record a short demo of the incident and upload it to youtube and submitting a complaint against the user on forum to let other admin know and proof them that the user was breaking rules.


7) Have you gained experience as an administrator before?
Yes I have gained a past experience as administrator but I got kicked out from the team totally out of my own fault, I agree that I have did shit towards mason and I apologized and I hope we will be able to find a good track together again, communication and understatement is a key point.


[8)] When do you play? (timetable of your average week)
My timetable could change on daily basis so I don't want to post here hours I would not be able to do, or would be unavailable but I can assure that I'm more than capable of being on the server for couple of hours daily.


9) User 1 calls user 2 a "cunt" and proceeds to insult him further - what actions would you take?
If I know the players and know that they are friends I would allow it until it's not a excessive amount where it ruins gaming for other, but if they are random players then I would first start investigation by talking talking with user 2 first to see how it happened then talk to user 1 and try to come out with peaceful solution to this as not always stuff requires a ban or a kick, if behavior like this continues from user 1 I would warn him and mute him for insulting, if he would continue to behave in such a way by insulting in chat or voice I would ban him for appropriate amount of time by looking at his previous ban history.


10) Strengths
- Clear English communication via voice and written messages.
- Strict in appropriate times but can also be fun.
- Easily approachable.
- Know the language Polish so If explanation for a user is needed I can help.
- Trusted by players from Knife and TTT server.
- Have previous Admin experience.
- Respectful ( most of the times )
- Attention to detail.
- Good Rule understanding .


11) Weaknesses
- Maturity ( This I'm still improving and working towards getting it perfect )
- I make mistakes as everyone, we are all humans and not everyone is perfect.


12) Conclusion / Closing remark
Thank you for reading my application, I hope I have created a good application and that I would be accepted for a last time, I wanna show all the players I can be trusted and I just wanna bring these players fun and stop the rule breakers from taking over the server, I also hope my behavior has not impacted a lot of the players in the last week or two as I said before everyone is a human and everyone makes mistakes, I wanna clear this mistake and set out a example in being a good admin and a respectful and trusted friend of many players here.

Hallo Oxygen mein Freund!
